requirements.name: Chrome or Chromium-based browser
requirements.note: Any Chromium-based browser works: Google Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Microsoft Edge, or Arc. Used to render the app's own UI window, same as the rest of this family of apps.

requirements.name: A native folder-picker dialog
requirements.note: Linux only: uses zenity (GNOME default) or kdialog (KDE default) to choose a folder to rename files in, since a browser page can't hand back a real filesystem path itself. macOS and Windows use their own built-in pickers — nothing extra needed there.
